title: Anyone using G6 with Xdrip on Samsung S7 willing to share settings?
symptom: The user cannot set up G6 with xDrip on a Samsung S7 and asks for help with settings.
fix: Update to the latest nightly and disable the 'Minimize Scanning' option in the G5 Debug settings. Alternatively, download the 7/15/18 version and take the defaults.
evidence_quote: Please update to the latest nightly and disable the `Minimize Scanning` option in the G5 Debug settings.
